info.name: Pathfinder Functional Backend API
info.description:
Pathfinder Functional Backend API Collection
Updated: August 31, 2026

Authentication:
All endpoints except /api/auth/* and /api/validation/*
require a JWT in the Authorization header:
  Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

To authenticate:
1. Run Auth/Register or Auth/Login.
2. The test script automatically saves the token to
   the token environment variable.
3. All subsequent requests use {{token}} automatically.

Token expiry: 7 days. Re-run login if requests return 401.

exec: console.log('Token saved to environment variable: token');
console.log('Token saved to environment variable: token');
